summary: Tecnoglass Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend rather than a transformative event. The board declared $0.15 per share for Q3 2026, equal to $0.60 annualized, payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. No price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock applies. The filing is a capital-return disclosure under Item 8.01 with the press release as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for continued quarterly declarations and payout consistency; no arbitrage angle exists.
